answers.core: Given [the Godot editor will soon be available on Android](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/57747), improving the touchscreen usability of Godot's GUI system will become increasingly important.
answers.workaround: No. This *may* be feasible as an add-on, but it's not exactly trivial.

title: Increase PopupMenu spacing when it is brought up by a touch event (in contrast to a mouse event)
